_comment: Mutation testing scope: the deterministic gameplay core only. These are the modules where a subtly wrong comparison silently changes a match — legality, transitions, the save/replay validators. Scenes, rendering, network glue and the AI are deliberately out: see docs/TESTING.md#mutation-testing. Run with `npm run test:mutation`; it is a diagnostic, not a gate, and no score threshold is enforced.
_comment_runner: Command runner, not @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner: that runner predates vitest 5 and reports zero tests per mutant against it, which silently marks every mutant as survived. The command below is the ordinary vitest CLI, so a non-zero exit is a killed mutant whatever vitest version the repo is on. Revisit when the vitest runner supports vitest 5.
